title: Intermittent Claude Branding Insertion in Commit/PR Messages
body:
**Bug Description**
I have to keep telling CC to remove any Claude branding in commit message and PR message. Adding it to global memory with # helped reduce the frequency CC adding branding to everything, but it still comes up from time to time. 

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 1.0.22
- Feedback ID:
author: ouj
